node.title: Mozilla IoT platform Perl wrapper
node.author: stevieb
node.doctext:
As many of you know, I've spent the last four plus years working on software that allows us Perl hackers to muck with the Raspberry Pi.

Although the uptake is relatively small, it has been a very enjoyable experience for me providing this for the community, especially given that I've received welcome and helpful feedback, along with bug fixes and wonderful criticism throughout it all.

Now, Mozilla is opening up their [https://iot.mozilla.org/|IoT Platform] with both REST and WebSocket APIs for the masses. I've been following it for a little while to see where it goes.

I've already thrown out the question on my [http://blogs.perl.org/users/steve_bertrand/2019/10/desire-for-perl-wrapper-of-mozillas-iot-platform.html|Perl blog], but it means more to me to ask here on Perlmonks; would it be worth my time to ensure Perl has an interface to it?

-stevieb
